description: ECDH-ES on a P-256 and an X25519 key fails with MultipleMatchingKeys; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): ECDH-ES is served by both P-256 (RFC 7518 §4.6) and X25519 (RFC 8037 §3.2), neither member has alg, use or key_ops, and the selector has no kid, so two match (§4); crv selection is backlog (ADR 0054 Consequences); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
